title: Delaney Nyenhuis named WIAC women's basketball player of the week
text:
Delaney Nyenhuis, bastketball player | UW-Eau Claire Blugolds
Delaney Nyenhuis, bastketball player | UW-Eau Claire Blugolds
Delaney Nyenhuis of the University of Wisconsin-Eau Claire has been named the Wisconsin Intercollegiate Athletic Conference (WIAC) Women's Basketball Player of the Week for November 24 to 30. The announcement was made by the WIAC, with the selection determined through an anonymous vote among conference head coaches and Sports Information Directors.
Nyenhuis played a key role in helping the Blugolds extend their winning streak to five games, securing victories against St. Norbert College and the University of Minnesota-Morris. In the game against St. Norbert on November 25, she achieved her third double-double of the season by scoring 10 points and collecting 12 rebounds, including four on offense. On November 30, Nyenhuis continued her strong performance with 13 rebounds—seven of which were offensive—and averaged 12.5 rebounds over both games that week.
Defensively, Nyenhuis averaged 4.5 steals per game as UW-Eau Claire converted turnovers into a total of 27 points across their two wins.
"Delaney Nyenhuis has been named the Women's Basketball Player of the Week by anonymous vote of WIAC head coaches and Sports Information Directors," according to the WIAC announcement.
